preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of vertices N must be between 1 and 15.
The number of edges M must be less than half the product of N and N-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= N and 1 <= Y <= N for X, Y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge vertices X and Y must be within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the values of x and y separated by a space.
The values of x and y must satisfy the equation Ax = By.
Both x and y must be positive integers.
